purpose: Defines rules for reading and writing document IDs, Markdown parsing, anchor generation, content hash computation, and AI-generated field limits and validation.
summary: Frontmatter doc_link_id is read with minimal parsing; missing or unrecognized values count as no ID
Only DLIDs are written, at frontmatter or heading ends, verified by re-parsing and atomic replace
Markdown is parsed with markdown-it-py following CommonMark link rules
Section ranges run from a heading to the next heading of the same or higher level
Content hash is SHA-256 of raw UTF-8 text, with formal reference titles excluded
Titles record the first 12 hex characters of the hash
Section hashes cover the section range text
AI-generated fields have per-field limits L and array minimum counts, in English
tasks: Implementing Markdown parsing and DLID writing
Writing test vectors for hashes and link rules
title: DES-008 Markdown 解析・比較値・生成情報の規則
